verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own docs state it provides official TypeScript, Python, and Java SDKs plus a REST API for the Connect service that underpins Pipedream MCP. Code samples show client connection to the remote MCP server and loading tools in the Vercel AI SDK. missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference docs (versioning, coverage of MCP-specific operations) in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
